"""strike: one attack tap a call on the sword's cooldown, aim untouched; a record of every call (an instrument)."""
import json, sys
LOOP = True
s = json.load(sys.stdin)
with open("mine/strike_calls.jsonl", "a") as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({"step": s["step"], "call": s["call"], "health": s["health"],
                        "pitch": round(s["pos"]["pitch"], 1), "yaw": round(s["pos"]["yaw"], 1),
                        "x": round(s["pos"]["x"], 2), "z": round(s["pos"]["z"], 2)}) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"actions": [{"action": {"attack": 1}, "repeat": 1}, {"action": {}, "repeat": 13}],
                  "again": True, "note": "tap %d" % s["call"] if s["call"] % 10 == 0 else ""}))
